decision_source: Existing A2-valid M0 Bridge records only
selection_rule: Choose the one frozen M0 checkpoint with the smallest previously frozen 0.5 clean + 0.5 mean S1-S6 A2-valid selection loss; no test access or metric-based reselection.
ensemble_rationale: No deterministic multi-seed aggregation rule was previously validated or preregistered; introducing one at final test time would add an unreviewed model variant.
classification_rule: Use the selected checkpoint's three raw logits; argmax with class order 0 Negative, 1 Neutral, 2 Positive. No calibration, threshold tuning, logit aggregation or test-time augmentation.
regression_rule: Use the selected checkpoint's continuous 3*tanh regression output unchanged. No rounding, clipping, calibration or aggregation.

input_rule.split: official A2 unaligned test, one-time evaluation only
input_rule.text: test raw_text -> pinned FrozenUnalignedTextAdapter -> [3,50] token triplet and [50,768] float32 BERT states; attention_mask -> text P/O padding states
input_rule.audio: frozen cleaning_2026e_v2 unaligned [500,74] standardized features and frozen P/O
input_rule.vision: frozen cleaning_2026e_v2 unaligned [500,35] standardized features and frozen P/O
input_rule.mask_policy: M0 excludes only P=0 from key/pooling support; P=2 remains available; M0 does not add M1 state embeddings or infer missingness from zeros.
input_rule.sample_policy: preserve official A2 test row order and IDs, no deletion or vision_lengths truncation

test_evaluation_rule.label_mapping: regression y<0 -> 0 Negative; y==0 -> 1 Neutral; y>0 -> 2 Positive; regression target retains original y

A3_policy: future unlabeled inference only, no A3 access or predictions at this stage
failure_policy: Worse test performance alone never changes the predictor. Investigate only a verified implementation mismatch; report failure rather than selecting another checkpoint.
